description: Documentation, CI, and a top-level fidelity summary tying the new secondary council/region reports together. Make the data-driven, reusable-template nature explicit so any future data (or the future primary level) renders through the same templates.
steps: Update the top-level README.md: keep the existing lakezone section as the documented SUCCESS EXAMPLE, and add a section describing the reports/ tree, the LEVEL+FUNCTION naming convention (with an explicit note that 'MWANZA CC'/'Mwanza' are the test council/region instances, not template names), the secondary-now / primary-future split, the shared fonts.css (real fonts, no fallbacks) and the font licensing decision point, and the per-report render+compare workflow.

Add a per-report short README (or a top reports/secondary/INDEX.md) listing every report, its source PDF, its scope/level, its page count, and its latest fidelity scores (pixel-diff, word-diff) so the verdict is visible at a glance, mirroring how output/comparison/README.md works for the lakezone example.

Update .github/workflows/compare.yml (or add a companion workflow) so CI renders and compares the new reports too: install the repo fonts (or fonts-liberation), loop over reports/secondary/**, render each data.json with its own template dir, run compare.py against each reference/original.pdf, and commit the output/ + comparison artifacts back. Keep the existing lakezone job working.

Provide a single convenience entrypoint (e.g. extend scripts/render_and_compare.py or add scripts/build_all.py) that discovers every report dir under reports/secondary/** and renders+compares them in one command, so regenerating everything is one step.

Write a BLOCKERS/decisions note (in the PR-facing docs, e.g. a section in reports/README.md) capturing: the font substitution decision (no genuine Arial/Times obtainable in-sandbox; metric-compatible Liberation/Tinos used under the real family names), any report that could not reach near-zero fidelity and why, and the primary-level future placeholder.
acceptance_criteria: README.md documents the new reports/ layout, naming convention, secondary/primary split, and fonts approach, while preserving the lakezone success-example section.
A visible fidelity summary (INDEX.md or per-report READMEs) lists each report's source, scope, page count, and latest pixel/word diff scores.
.github/workflows/compare.yml renders+compares the new reports in addition to the lakezone example without breaking the existing job.
A single command regenerates and compares all secondary reports.
A blockers/decisions note records the font substitution and any imperfect reports.
verification: Run the single build-all command and confirm it renders + compares every report under reports/secondary/** without error.
Lint/parse the updated compare.yml (e.g. `python -c "import yaml,sys; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/compare.yml'))"`) to confirm valid YAML.
Confirm the fidelity summary file exists and lists all built reports with scores.
findings:
Docs + CI + fidelity summary + build-all entrypoint + blockers note all delivered; nothing regressed. Verified: `python scripts/build_all.py` discovers all 16 report dirs (7 council + 9 region, incl. the dual-source region-schools-rank-subjectwise EDK+English) and renders+compares every one -> '=== build-all OK ==='. compare.yml parses as valid YAML (jobs: compare, compare-secondary). Lakezone success example still renders 11 pages (rendered to /tmp, no committed lakezone source/artifact touched).

1) README.md: KEPT the whole lakezone section as the documented SUCCESS EXAMPLE; ADDED a 'Beyond the success example: the reports/ tree' section covering the reports/ layout, LEVEL+FUNCTION naming (explicit that 'MWANZA CC'/'Mwanza' are the test council/region INSTANCE names in data.json values, not template names), secondary-now/primary-future split, fully-self-contained-per-report rule (own template + own CSS + inline @font-face, NO shared stylesheet; only COMPETENCY LEVEL bg is data-driven, everything else fixed), real-fonts-no-fallback + licensing decision-point cross-link, and the render+compare workflow. Updated Next steps to mention filling primary/ later.

2) reports/secondary/INDEX.md (NEW): visible fidelity verdict mirroring output/comparison/README.md - one table per level listing every built report with source PDF, scope/level, page count, and LATEST pixel-diff range + word-diff (miss/extra) totals pulled by re-running build_all and parsing each output/comparison*/README.md. Includes a 'how to read the scores' note (pixel-diff = Liberation-vs-Arial glyph-edge noise; word-diff = compare.py fuzzy-tokeniser artifacts, content verified correct) and the byte-identical Governments-duplicate md5 note. 17 report rows (16 dirs; subjectwise split EDK+English).

3) .github/workflows/compare.yml: KEPT the existing lakezone 'compare' job byte-for-byte; ADDED a companion 'compare-secondary' job that installs fonts-liberation + Pango, copies repo fonts/ into ~/.local/share/fonts + fc-cache, pip installs, runs `python scripts/build_all.py`, and commits reports/secondary back. Expanded push path triggers to include reports/** and fonts/**. Valid YAML confirmed.

4) scripts/build_all.py (NEW): single convenience entrypoint. Discovers every self-contained report dir under reports/secondary/** (dir owns template.html.j2 + style.css AND has data*.json), handles BOTH the standard shape (data.json + reference/original.pdf) and the multi-source shape (data_<tag>.json + reference/original_<tag>.pdf, used by region-schools-rank-subjectwise), and renders+compares each into its own output/. Flags: --level council|region, --no-compare. NEVER modifies report sources, only regenerates output/. Returns non-zero if any render/compare fails.

5) BLOCKERS/decisions note: added a 'Decisions / blockers' section to reports/README.md (PR-facing) capturing (a) the font substitution decision - no genuine Monotype Arial/Times obtainable in-sandbox, real metric-compatible Liberation files registered under the exact family names with one family per @font-face and NO fallback chain, table of which real file backs which family, SIL OFL note - and its residual-pixel-diff consequence; (b) the reports that cannot reach near-zero pixel fidelity and why (dense wide F/M/T grids at ~35-45% from per-glyph edge noise: council/region schools-rank-overall, region-schools-rank-governments, region-mobility, region subjectwise English; compare.py tokeniser artifacts on rotated headers / long kern-merged strings inflating word-diff) with content verified correct; (c) the primary-level future placeholder. Also added a 'Build + compare everything' section pointing at build_all.py / render_and_compare.py / INDEX.md.

STRICT RULES honoured: no shared report stylesheet introduced; nothing renamed to include instance names; templates stay data-driven; build-all + CI regenerate output/ only, never sources. Env note: PyYAML not preinstalled - `pip install pyyaml` to run the YAML-lint verification step.
